subject: Human Body
title: The Dermis
description: A fast breakdown of The Dermis for builders.

hook.text: Beneath the epidermis lies a thicker layer packed with blood vessels, nerves, and collagen fibers. This is the dermis.

buildup.text: Collagen gives skin strength. Elastin gives it bounce.

discovery.text: The dermis contains sweat glands, hair follicles, and nerve endings. It's where all the active biology of skin happens.

twist.text: Collagen production drops about 1% per year after age 25. That gradual loss is the primary driver of visible skin aging.

climax.text: The dermis is skin's engine room. It provides structure, sensation, and nourishment to the epidermis above.

punchline.text: The epidermis protects. The dermis powers everything underneath.

quiz.question: What causes skin to lose firmness with age?
options: Collagen production in the dermis declines about 1% per year
Sweat glands enlarge and stretch the skin
